title: Pointwise $\pm 1$ form of the BLR indicator
statement:
Fix $n \in \bbn$ and a Boolean-valued function $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$, and let $g : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be its $\pm 1$ lift, $g(x) = (-1)^{f(x)}$. Then for all $x, y \in \{0,1\}^n$,
\[
  \mathbf{1}\!\left[\, g(x \oplus y) = g(x)\,g(y) \,\right]
  \;=\;
  \frac{1 + g(x)\,g(y)\,g(x \oplus y)}{2},
\]
where $x \oplus y$ denotes the componentwise XOR and the left-hand side is $1$ when the equality holds and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: universally quantified over all x, y in {0,1}^n
replaced:
